warnings: The two internal elevations of WC2, called from A-27.

*** TILING HEIGHT DIFFERS FROM WC1 AND IT MATTERS FOR THE TAKE-OFF. *** Both WC1 and WC2 have 2.70 m ceilings, but WC1's elevations (A-25) hatch the tile full height while WC2's carry a separate 2.00 m dimension with the hatch stopping there. No note says so, so the WC2 tile extent is flagged tile_extent_inferred_from_dimension rather than asserted.

The granite counter is fully dimensioned here: top at 0.80 m, 0.60 m deep, 20 mm thick, with a 0.20 m upstand and a 1.00 m mirror above. 0.80 m is the same working height A-03 sets for the kitchen counter.
The 0.05 m fall between +3.35 and +3.33 is shown in section with a SLOPE label, confirming the two-level floor read off the A-27 plan.
Window 5 (1.75 x 0.60 awning, from A-23) appears over the counter at 0.90 m wide on รูปตัด B.
Only the plain H grab rail appears -- no H1/H2/H3 -- reinforcing that the full accessible rail set is a ground-floor-only provision.
